title: Compactness and Its Applications of Sobolev Spaces Associated with Ball Banach Function Spaces
summary: Let $N\in\mathbb{N}\cap[2,\infty),$ $Ω$ be a bounded Lipschitz domain in $\mathbb{R}^N$, and $X(Ω)$ be a ball Banach function space on $Ω.$ In this article, under some mild assumptions, we establish a compactness theorem for Sobolev spaces associated with $X(Ω)$. Different from the fractional Sobolev space, our proof is based on an elaborate decomposition of bounded Lipschitz domains and its corresponding weighted fractional Poincaré inequality on each piece.
